text: The first edit was messy: text was small, clipped and doubled, nothing like the reference videos. Text must be big, bold, auto-fitted inside the frame, one phrase at a time (no overlapping), with varied entrance and exit animations per word, like the references.

When asked for a great edit: use many transitions (real fire wipes, flame licks, glitch cuts, flashes), many animated text entries/exits, camera punch-ins on key words, sound design, and a strong grade. Be creative and dense.
Do not rely on a fixed brand colour: pick colours per video from the footage and the references.
